Title: Anonymous viewer is refused access to another user's draft post
Gherkin: Given a draft post owned by a basic user / When an anonymous visitor requests to view that post / Then the request is refused

Title: Unrelated basic user is refused access to another user's draft post
Gherkin: Given a draft post owned by a different basic user / When a signed-in basic user who is not the owner requests to view that post / Then the request is refused

Title: Owner can view a non-published post
Gherkin: Given a draft post owned by a basic user / When the post's own owner requests to view that post / Then the post is returned to the viewer

Title: Manager can view a non-published post
Gherkin: Given a draft post owned by a basic user / When a manager requests to view that post / Then the post is returned to the viewer

Title: Admin can view a non-published post
Gherkin: Given a draft post owned by a basic user / When an admin requests to view that post / Then the post is returned to the viewer

Title: Viewer without owner/manager/admin standing is refused access to a post in a non-published non-draft status
Gherkin: Given a post in a non-public status other than draft owned by a basic user / When an anonymous visitor requests to view that post / Then the request is refused

Title: Direct view of a restricted post returns an explicit refusal
Gherkin: Given a draft post owned by a basic user / When an anonymous visitor requests to view that post directly by its identifier / Then the request is refused with an explicit error response distinct from silent list-exclusion

Title: Restricted post is excluded from an unauthorized viewer's list results
Gherkin: Given a draft post owned by a basic user and a published post visible to everyone / When an anonymous visitor requests the list of posts / Then only the published post appears in the returned list

Title: Viewer without the required role does not see a locked field but sees the post's other fields
Gherkin: Given a published post with one field locked to the manager role and other fields unlocked / When a basic user without the manager role requests to view that post / Then the locked field is not present and other fields are present

Title: Manager sees a field locked to the manager role
Gherkin: Given a published post with one field locked to the manager role / When a manager requests to view that post / Then the locked field is present

Title: Admin sees a field locked to the manager role
Gherkin: Given a published post with one field locked to the manager role / When an admin requests to view that post / Then the locked field is present

Title: Anonymous visitor does not see the author's real name or email
Gherkin: Given a published post authored by a named user / When an anonymous visitor who is not the owner requests to view that post / Then content is present and author name/email are not present

Title: Unrelated basic user does not see the author's real name or email
Gherkin: Given a published post authored by a named user / When an unrelated basic user who is not the owner requests to view that post / Then content is present and author name/email are not present

Title: Manager sees the author's real name and email
Gherkin: Given a published post authored by a named user / When a manager requests to view that post / Then author name and email are present

Title: Admin sees the author's real name and email
Gherkin: Given a published post authored by a named user / When an admin requests to view that post / Then author name and email are present

Title: Post owner sees their own real name and email on their own post
Gherkin: Given a published post authored by a basic user with no relevant identity-viewing role / When that basic user as the post's owner requests to view their own post / Then author name and email are present

Title: Anonymous visitor cannot list posts when the deployment is private
Gherkin: Given a deployment configured as private and a published post / When an anonymous visitor requests the list of posts / Then the request is refused

Title: Anonymous visitor cannot view a normally-public post when the deployment is private
Gherkin: Given a deployment configured as private and a published post / When an anonymous visitor requests to view that post / Then the request is refused

Title: Anonymous visitor cannot register a new account when the deployment is private
Gherkin: Given a deployment configured as private / When an anonymous visitor attempts to register a new account / Then the request is refused

Title: Anonymous visitor cannot create a post when the deployment is private
Gherkin: Given a deployment configured as private / When an anonymous visitor attempts to create a new draft post / Then the request is refused

Title: Authenticated basic user retains normal post access when the deployment is private
Gherkin: Given a deployment configured as private and a published post / When a signed-in basic user requests to view that post / Then the post is returned to the viewer

Title: Self-service registration is refused when new registrations are disabled
Gherkin: Given a deployment with new registrations disabled / When a prospective user attempts to register through self-service / Then the request is refused

Title: Admin can still directly create a user account when self-service registration is disabled
Gherkin: Given a deployment with new registrations disabled / When an admin directly creates a new user account / Then the account is created

Title: User cannot delete media owned by a different user
Gherkin: Given a media item uploaded and owned by a different user / When a basic user who is not that media's owner attempts to delete it / Then the request is refused

Title: User cannot delete media with no identified owner
Gherkin: Given a media item uploaded anonymously with no identified owner / When a basic user who is not that media's owner attempts to delete it / Then the request is refused

Title: Admin deletes media that has no identified owner
Gherkin: Given a media item uploaded anonymously with no identified owner / When an admin attempts to delete that media item / Then the media item is deleted

Title: Admin deletes media owned by another user
Gherkin: Given a media item uploaded and owned by a basic user / When an admin attempts to delete that media item / Then the media item is deleted

Title: Manager cannot delete media owned by another user
Gherkin: Given a media item uploaded and owned by a basic user / When a manager who is not that media's owner attempts to delete it / Then the request is refused

Title: An anonymous report is submitted reviewed under field locks and its media cleaned up by its owner
Gherkin: Given an anonymous visitor submits a draft with a locked field / When a manager reviews it and the uploader deletes their own photo / Then the review sees the complete post and the deletion succeeds
